newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Shrs in three Haitai Group firms plunge on rumours.
newsitem.headline: Shrs in three Haitai Group firms plunge on rumours.

text.p: Shares in Haitai Confectionery Co and two other affiliates of the Haitai Group fell to their daily limits in late Wednesday morning trading on rumours that the group was in financial trouble, brokers said.
Haitai Confectionery was down 800 won to 10,300, Haitai Electronics Co down 1,000 won to 11,600 and Haitai Stores Co down 540 won to 6,310.
The group, ranked 24th, denied the rumours.
"It's not true. We are also surprised," a public relations official at the group said of the rumours.
All three of the stocks were heavily traded.

Brokers said similar rumours had circulated earlier this year. The companies were being affected again by rumours because of heightened concerns about corporate crises following Monday's news on the Dainong Group, they said.
Dainong, one of the nation's oldest conglomerates, was tapped by its main creditor bank for a bailout.
